title: 2025 AMC 10A Problem 15
statement: In the figure below, \(ABEF\) is a rectangle, \(AD \perp DE,\) \(AF = 7,\) \(AB = 1,\) and \(AD = 5.\) What is the area of \(\triangle ABC?\)

solutions.text: Let \(x = BC.\) Since \(ABEF\) is a rectangle with \(AB = 1\) and \(AF = 7,\) and \(AD = 5,\) we get \(AC = \sqrt{1 + x^2},\) \(CE = 7 - x,\) and \(CD = 5 - \sqrt{1 + x^2}.\) The triangles \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle EDC\) are similar, so \(\frac{7 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}} = \frac{5 - \sqrt{1 + x^2}}{x}.\) Clear denominators and square to get \(24x^2 + 14x - 24 = 0,\) which factors as \((4x - 3)(3x + 4) = 0.\) The positive root is \(x = \tfrac{3}{4}.\) So the area is \(\tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac34 \cdot 1 = \tfrac{3}{8}.\) Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Let \(x = BC.\) Then \(AC = \sqrt{1 + x^2},\) \(CE = 7 - x,\) and \(CD = 5 - \sqrt{1 + x^2}\)
Use \(\triangle ABC \sim \triangle EDC\) to set up a proportion, then solve for \(x\)
